evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、src/routes.ts、src/install.ts、src/backup.ts、src/http.ts；routes作为浏览器到宿主服务桥接，实际安装交给dsh-cli/install/profile模块。validateAddedPlugins从安装后磁盘枚举新增包，检查DSH manifest、可加载entry及与已有bundle的entry-id冲突，异常包执行移除与manifest对账。备份restore先验证路径和文件类型，用临时文件rename逐文件替换，并保留previous供错误时rollback。相对仅运行add命令，增量是将安装后的磁盘真相和加载冲突纳入办结标准；但逐文件rename不等于跨文件崩溃原子事务。
limitations: 本轮只读固定提交，未执行目标代码或宿主验收；效果、人工耗时及持续采用情况未知。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 目标是维护多个社区插件的DSH用户，任务包括发现、装入、更新和恢复profile；合格结果不是下载成功，而是profile仍能启动且目标插件实际接线。原办法为原生Discover加CLI及手动备份；README已承认同一目录可直接加入原生Discover，因此纯搜索并非独占价值。分组、备注、备份与故障恢复把多步维护放到一处，反复维护工作量较大时才更有价值。

依据固定包清单和作者安装说明核查分发；不以下载和Star证明采用。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 包与备份空间 | profile辨识和备份 | 时间未知 |
| 持续 | Git/npm下载及构建 | 更新核对 | 第三方插件另计 |
| 失败恢复 | 重试、快照空间 | 对账及外部终端救援 | 崩溃恢复覆盖未测 |
维护多个社区插件的DSH用户可先在克隆profile中试用安装和备份流程。相比分散CLI操作，市场加入加载校验和状态对账，但维护节时与全故障恢复未实测。若无法备份恢复或宿主鉴权版本不明，就停止修改主profile并退回原生Discover与人工维护。 依据 [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 维护链整合 | 路由和安装校验 | 相对CLI节时 |
| 错误处理 | 冲突移除与备份回滚 | 崩溃后全状态一致 |
安装后以磁盘真相对账值得复用，host gate复用避免第二套登录；移植必须同时处理profile所有权、包管理副作用和宿主版本，不能只搬UI。
[Q02](#research-q02)相对单次CLI安装，将新增包加载校验、entry冲突与磁盘manifest对账整合到维护链；它改变安装办结条件，但不是第三方插件安全保证。
[Q03](#research-q03)市场与宿主共处故障域，旧版鉴权及进程崩溃恢复需单独验证；单文件rename和catch回滚不能当跨文件事务。
[Q05](#research-q05)以独立profile试装和变更计划前移恢复责任，故障注入比较可启动性和修复耗时，假设未验证。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)多插件更新和profile恢复形成明确重复维护链，README63—75说明具体摩擦，取75%23；超一般场景50%，无需求样本不足100%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)install792—827有安装后加载/冲突校验，超仅入口包装50%而达75%19；原生Discover与CLI仍可替代且恢复覆盖未验，不足100%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)安装、备份、请求gate直接可追溯，取50%13，超局部25%；未执行故障测试不能75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)profile、包管理和重启多状态变更，回滚仍有崩溃窗口，取50%10；有备份/对账超过25%，并非轻接入75%。

研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核查DSH Market的具体任务增量、关键失败条件与可控采用路径。 ### Q01 · 多插件用户为什么需要额外市场，原生Discover是否已足够？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、采用判断 #### 完整回答 目标是维护多个社区插件的DSH用户，任务包括发现、装入、更新和恢复profile；合格结果不是下载成功，而是profile仍能启动且目标插件实际接线。原办法为原生Discover加CLI及手动备份；README已承认同一目录可直接加入原生Discover，因此纯搜索并非独占价值。分组、备注、备份与故障恢复把多步维护放到一处，反复维护工作量较大时才更有价值。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:12-14](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market/blob/e320461dba3a7e99845f83c7bd106a2f1889dc7f/README.md#L12-L14) 作者明确原生Discover可消费相同索引 ```text The plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness. On dsh 0.2.1+ it is a tab on the **Plugins** page, right next to **Installed**; on older hosts open Settings → **Plugin Market**. Browse, search, one-click install. > 📡 **The same catalog is also a plugin market index.** On dsh 0.2.1+, open **Plugins → Discover → Index sources** and add `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json`. That is this list as a format-1 index, served from npm so it loads quickly everywhere — dsh gives a source 15 seconds, and the GitHub Pages copies (`https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/index.json` and `https://dshmarket.com/index.json`) can exceed that from some networks. The host's Discover tab and the `plugin_market` agent tool then search it. ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:63-75](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market/blob/e320461dba3a7e99845f83c7bd106a2f1889dc7f/README.md#L63-L75) 维护流程主张及profile故障边界
查看原文（13行） ```text - **Favorites** — bookmark plugins and themes from Discover or the Themes tab; a dedicated Favorites tab lists them with search, sort, and install actions. Bookmarks persist in the profile's market state (`state.json`); entries that leave the catalog can be cleared in one click - **Groups** — organise installed plugins into named groups (rename, delete, and per-group search); a plugin lives in one group and ungrouped is the default. A group carries its own switch: all-on, all-off, or the mixed state its members are really in, so a working set can be switched as a unit without touching the rest. A group holds at most one theme. The grouping itself is local state in the profile's `state.json` - **Notes** — write your own one-line description for any installed plugin and it replaces the author's on that row, so a shelf of forty plugins answers "why did I install this" in your words. Stored locally beside groups and favorites, never sent anywhere - **Themes** — a dedicated tab for community themes and skins: install → active immediately, switch with one click (themes are mutually exclusive, your choice survives restarts), uninstall to revert - **One-click install** — confirm the source, watch live progress; most plugins go live after a page refresh, no restart - **Backup & restore** — export your profile's plugin list and configuration as readable JSON, import it on another machine, store it on WebDAV with daily auto-backup, or sync through a private GitHub Gist; restores **merge** (plugins installed after the backup are kept), validate before writing, and roll back on failure - **Updates** — per-plugin update checks (npm version or pinned commit vs HEAD), one-click update, or update everything at once; the market updates itself the same way. A plugin installed from an archive link is updated only through its own source: a catalog entry that merely shares the name is never offered as its update, so updating cannot silently replace it with a different plugin. Each row with an update pending carries a **What changed** link — the release notes, or the commits when the version cannot be aligned to one. A notice you are not acting on can be ignored for the rest of the boot instead of being dismissed again on every reload — scoped to the running host, so a restart brings the reminder back and ignoring it is never the same as turning it off - **Resilient GitHub routes** — in the China download region, Git refs, README content, and avatars each keep their own fallback order. The market remembers the last working route, switches only after transport/HTTP/payload validation fails, and rejects proxy error pages disguised as HTTP 200. If every built-in route fails, **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → GitHub acceleration** accepts one persistent custom HTTPS prefix; `DSHM_GITHUB_PROXY` remains the operator-owned override - **Public update API** — plugin-owned settings pages can use the versioned, capability-gated [update API v1](UPDATE-API-V1.md) (beta) instead of copying package-manager logic or depending on private Market UI responses - **Uninstall** — two-step confirm; plugins installed this session are removed live - **Hot disable / enable** — toggles write `- id: …` + `disabled: true|false` into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the official patch layer, mechanism ported from [dsh-plugin-hub](https://github.com/Noob-stupid/dsh-plugin-hub)): DSH's HMR re-composes within ~1s, no restart, and the loader re-applies the choice on every boot; hand-edited patch rows show as badges, host-infrastructure plugins are protected from toggling, and a malformed patch file is never made worse - **Restart when needed** — changes that cannot hot-load show a one-click restart beside the pending-change banner; the action is restricted to same-origin loopback requests - **Recovery when a restart does not come back** — DSH's boot is all-or-nothing: one plugin that cannot load stops the whole process, and the market's own UI dies with the host it was serving from. Now that failure prompt offers **Adjust plugins**: the ones DSH blamed are marked red and left unticked, you choose what should be enabled at the next start, the choice is written through the same `cordis.patch.yml` rows the market's own toggles use (plus `dsh.profile.bundles` for a disable-carrier), and the boot is retried. It is served by the detached restart helper on the same address the page was already polling, so it works even though the host is gone — and opening the URL fresh renders a standalone version of the same page. When DSH starts normally, none of it appears ```

This layer only * parses requests, calls the service modules, and serializes responses — * process spawning lives in dsh-cli.ts, filesystem reads in profile.ts, * orchestration in install.ts / themes.ts / updates.ts. * * Security: the install route executes a shell command, so it accepts only * same-origin POSTs and only sources present in the curated registry. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/install.ts:792-827](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market/blob/e320461dba3a7e99845f83c7bd106a2f1889dc7f/src/install.ts#L792-L827) 新增包与冲突校验
